text:
Situation: Alteplase 2.2 mg/2 mL vials are in short supply at both campuses. Corvale East holds 191 vials (20.4 days on hand). Corvale General holds 298 vials (28.6 days on hand). The 100 mg vial (NDC 50242-085-27) is not stocked.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include alteplase as of 2026-10-21. Genentech, Inc. posted a discontinuance notice for Alteplase Injection 100 mg vial (NDC 50242-085-27) with status To Be Discontinued and initial posting date 2026-05-21. The product label for NDC 50242004110 identifies Genentech, Inc. as labeler and manufacturer at FEI 3007232634, last inspected VAI 2024-04-19. That plant received a VAI classification on 2024-04-19 per inspection 1235654. A second Genentech plant (FEI 3006129086) is listed as a registered plant for analysis with last inspection NAI 2024-08-16.

Our position: Current inventory covers approximately three to four weeks of use. No alternate presentations are stocked. The manufacturer has announced discontinuance of the 100 mg vial only. Supply continuity for the 2.2 mg/2 mL vial is uncertain.

Recommended actions:
1. Pharmacy buyer to contact Genentech and authorized distributors to confirm allocation status and expected release dates for the 2.2 mg/2 mL vial; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
2. Pharmacy buyer to evaluate emergency purchase of alternative thrombolytic agents if available; requires P&T Committee approval.
3. Pharmacy informatics to build order sets for alternative agents pending formulary review; requires P&T Committee approval.
4. Pharmacy Director to implement allocation protocol reserving stock for STEMI and acute ischemic stroke protocols; requires Medical Staff Executive Committee approval.

Not recommended: Switching to the 100 mg vial presentation due to manufacturer discontinuance notice.
